result:
Lint clean, typecheck clean, full test suite passes (617/617). Summary of the fix:

- **types/issue.ts**: added status-group expansion (`open`/`closed`), calendar-date vs timestamp `due_before` handling (`dueBeforeCutoff`), and widened `IssueFilter.assigneeId`/`authorId` to accept `"me"`, plus an `archivedOnly` field.
- **schemas/common.ts / schemas/issue.ts**: `issueFilterSchema` now accepts the same vocabulary (status groups, `"me"`, calendar-date `due_before`, `archivedOnly`) instead of refusing it.
- **hooks/issue-filter-params.ts**: the URL codec expands status groups, validates `due_before` as date-or-timestamp, passes `"me"` through, and distinguishes `archived=1` vs `archived=only`.
- **server/repositories/issue-repository.ts**: fixed `assigneeId: null` (unassigned) to actually filter with `isNull` instead of being ignored; labels are now AND-ed (all-of) instead of OR-ed; `due_before` uses the resolved cutoff; `archivedOnly` lists archived rows exclusively.
- **server/services/issue-service.ts**: resolves `"me"` against the acting user before hitting the repository.
- **Pages**: the project issues page and "My issues" page no longer hand-roll their own query parsing — they go through the shared codec/schema, so labels/priority/assignee/due-before/archived all work consistently and the status vocabulary (`open`) is shared.
- **config/nav.ts / app-sidebar.tsx**: fixed the actual root cause of the "Assigned to me" 404 — the query string was being URL-encoded as a literal path segment (`issues%3Fassignee%3Dme`); query params are now carried separately and appended properly.
- **issue-filter-bar.tsx**: added an archived-scope control (live / include archived / archived only).
